title: Academia catalog - US elite / R1 core (universities -> mapped entities)
source: Public record: university & company founding histories; patent assignments (Stanford PageRank US6285999B1, assigned to Stanford, licensed to Google); alumni records; public federal-research / DoD FFRDC-UARC relationships (JHU APL, CMU SEI, GaTech GTRI). Structural overlay; every edge graded in its note. Academia epic, chunks #201 (schema) + #202 (US elite/R1 core).

edges.notes: Brin & Page founded Google from Stanford PhD research; PageRank patent (US6285999B1) assigned to Stanford, exclusively licensed to Google, Stanford took equity (fact).
Co-founders Peter Thiel (Stanford BA/JD) and Alex Karp (Stanford JD) met at Stanford Law (fact).
Thiel: Stanford BA philosophy 1989, JD 1992; founded The Stanford Review (fact).
Jensen Huang earned a Stanford MSEE (1992) before co-founding NVIDIA (fact).
Musk enrolled in a Stanford applied-physics PhD in 1995 and left within days to start Zip2 (fact; a nominal tie, noted as such).
Zuckerberg founded Facebook (now Meta) at Harvard in 2004 (fact).
Bill Gates left Harvard (1975) to co-found Microsoft (fact).
Jeff Bezos, Princeton BSE 1986, founded Amazon in 1994 (fact).
Gordon Moore, Caltech PhD 1954, co-founded Intel (fact).
Marc Andreessen (UIUC; NCSA Mosaic -> Netscape) co-founded Andreessen Horowitz (fact).
Elon Musk: Penn BA economics + BS physics (1997) (fact).
